scope: Six unpenalized CPU generalized/censored regression distributions and saved prediction, all exact/left/right/interval likelihood terms; not full JMP Generalized Regression parity.
integration_status: Frozen numeric implementation validated: 33 focused censored tests; parent workspace1340 passed with2 existing ignored; strict analytics all-target Clippy and scoped formatting passed. Final Release exported C ABI and matching loaded native DuckDB SQL independent checks passed768 scalar/contract assertions across both boundaries. Bounded partial Generalized Regression contracts only; no installed-JMP comparison.

parameterization.exponential: log mu=Xbeta,mean mu; no free scale
parameterization.gamma: log mu=Xbeta,shape mu/sigma,scale sigma,common sigma>0 (not fixed-shape GLM)
parameterization.weibull: log response SEV location mu=Xbeta,scale sigma; Weibull shape1/sigma,scale exp(mu)
parameterization.lognormal: log response Normal location mu=Xbeta,scale sigma

common_contract.censoring: Weighted sum logpdf(exact),logCDF(upper;left),logSF(lower;right),log[CDF(upper)-CDF(lower)](interval). Numerically smaller tail evaluated directly and interval difference formed in log space. No replacement of censored observations by endpoints. Original physical interval width is retained before normal-response centering. Exponential/Weibull use stable exact cumulative-hazard differences; Lognormal uses log1p relative endpoint increments; Normal/Gamma/Beta unresolved/narrow intervals integrate an analytic log-density ratio using Gauss-Legendre16/32/64/128, requiring successive log-integrals within2e-13*(1+abs(log_integral_ratio)), otherwise error. Agreement is a numerical consistency check,not a rigorous certified quadrature error bound.
common_contract.frequency: Nonnegative integer replication frequencies 0..1e6, with total frequency <=1e9 and greater than the number of estimated parameters. Zero-frequency rows do not enter fitting. Repeating rows and supplying their frequencies give the same likelihood and information. Frequencies are replication counts, not analytic or survey weights. A single exponential row is allowed when its total replication frequency exceeds one.
common_contract.normal_scale: The normal operation uses joint censored maximum-likelihood scale even when every row is exact. JMP uses least-squares RMSE in its uncensored normal regression path. This explicit convention difference remains an open item in the overall parity ledger.
common_contract.preprocessing: Training-only frequency-weighted origin+mean-offset/population feature scales; weighted QR full-rank check. Normal response additionally centered/scaled for numerical conditioning. Saved normalized coefficients/transforms used for prediction.
common_contract.optimizer: Local average-NLL finite-difference BFGS with automatic initial fit and three scale starts. maxiter0 returns diagnostic initial fit. Stop on maximum numerical gradient<=tolerance; coefficient absolute1e6 and log scale[-30,30] are numerical guard limits. Guard-bound convergence forbidden. No proof of global optimum or all forms of recession/nonidentification.
common_contract.uncertainty: Joint observed summed-likelihood information uses Richardson-extrapolated central differences. Invert only positive-definite information with relative Cholesky pivots >1e-12. Return original coefficient/log_sigma covariance, standard errors, and normal Wald confidence intervals; predictions use delta uncertainty for conditional means and quantiles. Nonconverged fits withhold inference and saved uncertainty. If original-unit covariance is unrepresentable, it is null and inference_valid=false, while finite normalized covariance may remain available for saved prediction. The Beta mean derivative uses logistic(eta)*logistic(-eta). A mean Wald interval with unrepresentable endpoints is null while its finite mean and standard error remain available.
common_contract.bounds: Finite data with absolute values <=1e150; at most 100000 rows, 1024 columns, and 1 million numeric cells. Fitting supports p<=16 features. The entire public call has a cumulative numerical work limit of 200 million units, including every start, finite-difference gradient/Hessian, and prediction inverse CDF. Gamma and Beta shapes must be positive and <=1e6. Special-function fractions/series stop after 10000 iterations and reject if not converged.
common_contract.verification: 33 focused tests; parent workspace1340 passed/0failed/2existing ignored and strict analytics all-target Clippy. Final Release actual ds_analytics_run/free and native DuckDB SQL:6 mixed-censor/two-feature fits, saved prediction/inference, and4 confirmed edge contracts per boundary;768 total scalar/contract checks, including46 edge checks. Fixture optimizer tolerance is documented default1e-7; independent average-NLL score<=2e-7 required. Numeric reference tolerances unchanged. Evidence:tasks/evidence/jmp-censored-reference.json. This does not establish complete JMP platform or head-to-head parity.
common_contract.identification: The weighted fixed-design QR check rejects constant or aliased predictors. All-left and all-right fits without opposite bounds are rejected. With free dispersion, no exact failures, and a common nonempty censor interval, a zero-dispersion supremum is rejected. Other covariate-dependent recession paths are not completely certified; global_optimum_verified remains false. Nonconverged fits return point diagnostics but withhold covariance, standard errors, and confidence intervals.
common_contract.work_budget: One thread-local counter is reset per public module call. All fitting starts and all prediction rows share it. Charges are 8 per input cell, rows*d per likelihood evaluation, 12/20 per Gamma series/fraction iteration, 40 per Beta fraction iteration, 6*order per Gauss root iteration, 8*d*d per BFGS step, 4*d^3 for covariance inversion, 4*d^4 for its raw-unit transformation, and 8*d*d+32 per prediction row. This bounds algorithmic work, not CPU instructions. Exhaustion returns an error before a fit or prediction is returned.
common_contract.support: Exact responses are positive for Exponential/Gamma/Weibull/Lognormal and strictly between zero and one for Beta. JMP 19.2 documents the exponential density on y>0 (images/12-20.png on its Statistical Details for Distributions page); actual JMP boundary behavior was not executed. Queries outside the open support return zero density and boundary probabilities. A positive-family quantile that rounds to zero, or a Beta quantile that rounds to one, is rejected explicitly. Quantile probabilities must lie strictly between zero and one.
common_contract.gamma_small_tail: For shape a<.25 and scaled x<=1, use P=exp(a*log(x)-logGamma(1+a))*(1+a*S), where S=sum(n>=1)(-x)^n/(n!*(a+n)). Form small Q with -expm1(prefactor)-exp(prefactor)*a*S. The 32-term zeta expansion of logGamma(1+a) avoids forming rounded 1+a; its omitted tail is bounded by 2*a^33/(33*(1-a)). The alternating series has a next-term remainder bound for x<=1. Elsewhere, compute the actual smaller tail directly with the lower series or upper fraction. Preserve log(x) before y/sigma underflows. The implementation matches independent SciPy and 80-digit mpmath small-tail fixtures.
common_contract.numeric_units: Weighted feature and normal-response scales rescale magnitudes before squaring. Delta standard errors scale the gradient and covariance before their quadratic form, so a representable standard deviation survives variance underflow. Original-unit covariance is withheld if any positive diagonal underflows or any cell overflows; normalized saved prediction covariance is retained.
common_contract.saved_validation: A finite version-1 carrier must have matching length, p, family, and response/feature transforms. Feature and response scales must be positive. Covariance flag zero requires all-zero covariance entries. Flag one requires a symmetric positive-definite covariance; symmetry checks scale before differences and additions, including values near the maximum finite double.

operations.description: Normal joint censored maximum likelihood: [features...,lower,upper,kind0exact/1left/2right/3interval,frequency]; [maxiter=400,tol=1e-7,confidence=.95,optional raw starts].
operations.data: 0..16 numeric features followed by lower,upper,censor kind,nonnegative integer frequency. Exact endpoints agree; left uses upper,right uses lower,interval lower<upper. Finite unused endpoints are placeholders. Only positive-frequency rows fit; full-rank design and n_active>=p+1; total frequency>number of parameters and <=1e9.
args: Optional starts appear only after all three settings: original intercept,original slopes,log_sigma (omitted for exponential). Exactly p+1+[family!=exponential] starts.
unsupported: penalized/stepwise/validation-selection methods
automatic categorical/model-effect expansion or informative missing handling
profile-likelihood confidence intervals,LR effect comparisons,small-sample inference
left truncation/delayed entry,dependent censoring,frailty/random effects
global optimizer and finite-MLE identification proof
operations.known_value_reference: Closed form normal ML: arithmetic mean and population standard deviation.

operations.description: Saved censored-family mean,CDF,survival,density,quantile and observed-information delta uncertainty: [features...,query,probability] and complete predict_parameters.
operations.data: Same feature count as fit then evaluation response and quantile probability strictly(0,1). Out-of-support evaluation response returns zero density and boundary probabilities; query quantiles remain on distribution support.
args: Complete unchanged numeric predict_parameters vector from fitted model; not raw coefficient array.
unsupported: parameter-uncertainty integration over a full distribution
simultaneous confidence bands
profile likelihood or guaranteed support-respecting mean Wald intervals
operations.known_value_reference: Standard normal analytic mean/CDF/density and independent scipy.stats.norm.ppf.
